title: शून्य प्रतिशत ब्याज फसल ऋण योजना — नया ऑनलाइन किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड (म.प्र., 2026-27)
description: SahkarAI explains MP Commissioner Cooperation circular 1458/2026 and GoMP order F 12-01/2020/15-1 dt 30.06.2026: online KCC application and approval, one annual credit limit with a 12-month due date, 5-year validity, and the 2026-27 interest terms.
